subject: Use BonfyreFrappeCompiler as the execution spine for the nine-lineage company gauntlet

body.trigger: The native receipt reports BonfyreFrappeCompiler built successfully and schema-ingestion smoke tests pass.
required_actions: Read the compiler's current registered lineage catalog and generate the cross-lineage ownership/dependency graph from that source of truth; do not hard-code an outdated app list.

Compile one shared company flow whose objects cross multiple registered Frappe lineages: customer/support -> commercial/fulfillment/accounting -> people/knowledge -> analytics/content as available in the registry.
Each cross-lineage mutation must remain a WorkGraph obligation with authority/effect receipt, not direct database choreography.
Feed schema/type information into ContextCompiler and Projection Kernel so UI/API projections derive from the same canonical object contracts.
Use tiny fixtures and transactional rollback/replay. Do not seed a large ERP dataset merely to prove the path.
Record which native Powers and lineages were actually exercised; uncovered lineages become explicit coverage debt for the saturation matrix.
body.acceptance: At least one real compiled flow crosses three or more registered Frappe lineages, reaches ReceiptEnvelope/EvidenceGraph, and replays without duplicate effects.
